interpretation: The correctness defect on unchanged Check is fixed. In the five-run Release simulator A/C comparison, first and changed Check medians improved only about 1.1x; unchanged cache-hit median improved about 1.6x, which is not compiler throughput. No several-fold compilation improvement is demonstrated. A local Debug CPU sample placed most compiler-thread samples within WasmKit lazy function translation, but it is not a user-device speed claim. Release-mode physical-device A/B/C measurements remain required.
